{"subject":"Modernising a 2B events/day shipment-tracking cluster","body":"Hi Joris,

Lumen Logistics' shipment-tracking service writes 2B events a day to DataStax Enterprise 6.8, and your team is focused on modernising that cluster and reducing operational toil. With IBM having completed its DataStax acquisition in May 2025, it's a sensible point to review options.

ScyllaDB offers migration tooling and support for moving live Cassandra/DSE workloads, so a high-volume event stream like yours has a supported path off the current cluster.

Would it be useful if I sent over an outline of how that migration path works for a workload like this?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["s03"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_migrate"],"context_fact_ids":["cf_ibm"]}
